summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K announcing its 2026 first interim dividend of 8.88 US cents per ordinary share, declaring payment mechanics for UK, Hong Kong, Singapore, and ADR holders. A scrip dividend alternative (Hong Kong line only) and a Dividend Reinvestment Plan are offered. Key dates: ex-dividend 10 Sep 2026, record 11 Sep 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration with no special-situation transaction, M&A, or restructuring element. The filing merely communicates standard corporate dividend procedures and election deadlines, not a capital return event or strategic action.
